products.text:
Type: tripod table lamp
Use: ambient and reading light; living room, bedroom, home office; on a side table, nightstand or console
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: black-finished wood legs, brushed nickel stem and collar, textured linen-look fabric shade
Colors: black, oatmeal white, silver
Shape: wide drum shade on a short metal stem, three slim tapered splayed legs, tall and open, light visual weight
Feel: graphic, airy, relaxed
Goes with: walnut or light wood, white or grey walls, black and nickel accents; mid-century or modern rooms

Type: glazed ceramic table lamp
Use: accent and bedside light; bedroom, living room, home office; on a nightstand, side table or shelf
Style: contemporary, coastal, bohemian
Materials: glossy crackle-glazed ceramic base with relief pattern, linen-look fabric shade, nickel neck
Colors: dark teal blue, white
Shape: small bottle-shaped base with a flared neck and raised geometric triangle pattern, tall cylindrical drum shade, compact
Feel: crafted, cozy, rich
Goes with: white walls, natural wood, navy or rattan accents; coastal or eclectic rooms

Type: small glass table lamp
Use: soft accent and bedside light; bedroom, living room, home office; on a nightstand, shelf or desk
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: clear hammered glass base, light grey fabric shade, clear cord
Colors: clear, light grey
Shape: rounded bottle-shaped glass base with visible cord, short cylindrical drum shade, compact and light
Feel: airy, calm, delicate
Goes with: white or pale walls, light wood, soft neutrals; Scandinavian or minimalist rooms

Type: patterned ceramic table lamp
Use: ambient and reading light; living room, bedroom; on a side table, console or nightstand
Style: traditional, coastal, classic
Materials: glazed ceramic base with fretwork print, linen-look fabric shade, nickel fittings
Colors: white, cobalt blue, warm beige shade
Shape: tall faceted hexagonal base tapering at the bottom, interlocking lattice pattern, drum shade, medium visual weight
Feel: fresh, elegant, timeless
Goes with: white walls, navy textiles, brass or wood; coastal, traditional or chinoiserie rooms

Type: ribbed ceramic table lamp
Use: accent and bedside light; bedroom, living room, home office; on a nightstand, side table or shelf
Style: contemporary, rustic, coastal
Materials: reactive-glazed ceramic base with textured ribbing, linen-look fabric shade
Colors: dark navy blue, warm brown flecks, white
Shape: slim bottle-shaped base with horizontal textured bands, tall cylindrical drum shade, compact
Feel: earthy, cozy, crafted
Goes with: natural wood, white or cream walls, blue textiles; farmhouse, coastal or modern rooms

Type: Himalayan salt bowl lamp
Use: soft glowing mood light; bedroom, living room, home office; on a nightstand, shelf or desk
Style: bohemian, rustic
Materials: natural rock salt bowl and salt balls, light wood base
Colors: warm orange, pale pink, light natural wood
Shape: rough-hewn round bowl filled with salt spheres on a round wooden plinth, small and chunky
Feel: warm, calming, natural
Goes with: natural wood, plants, warm neutrals; bohemian or relaxed rooms

Type: globe stick table lamp
Use: accent light; living room, bedroom, home office; on a side table, desk or console
Style: mid-century modern, glam, contemporary
Materials: terrazzo base, brushed brass stem, opal glass globe shade
Colors: blush pink, white, brass, black speckles
Shape: round milky globe on a slim brass rod, cylindrical terrazzo base, slender and tall, light visual weight
Feel: playful, soft, chic
Goes with: pink or white walls, brass accents, velvet; modern or glam rooms

Type: arched chrome table lamp
Use: reading and ambient light; living room, bedroom, home office; on a side table, desk or console
Style: contemporary, modern, art deco
Materials: polished chrome, white fabric shade
Colors: silver chrome, white
Shape: curved arm rising from a round disc base and hanging a wide drum shade, small lever detail at the base, open and sculptural
Feel: sleek, polished, graphic
Goes with: white or grey walls, glass and black accents; modern or glam rooms

Type: arc floor lamp
Use: overhead reading light beside a sofa or chair; living room, bedroom, home office; on the floor
Style: modern, mid-century modern, minimalist
Materials: black metal arc and base, linen-look fabric shade
Colors: matte black, warm beige
Shape: tall sweeping arched arm over a seat, wide drum shade hanging down, rectangular weighted base, tall but slim
Feel: dramatic, warm, relaxed
Goes with: neutral sofas, wood floors, black accents; modern or industrial living rooms

Type: striped ceramic table lamp
Use: accent and bedside light; bedroom, living room; on a nightstand, side table or shelf
Style: coastal, contemporary, farmhouse
Materials: glossy reactive-glazed ceramic base, linen-look fabric shade, nickel neck
Colors: creamy white, slate blue, grey
Shape: rounded gourd-shaped base with drippy blue bands, tall cylindrical drum shade, compact
Feel: fresh, soft, breezy
Goes with: white walls, light wood, blue and grey textiles; coastal or farmhouse rooms
